---
layout: post
title: some light complaining about self-hosting
---
<p>Spent this week attending protests against the ICE raids here in Los Angeles. I wish I was able to be more active on this blog, but I don't think it has enough unique users right now to be worth really worrying about. I think my goal is going to be to switch to a monthly post that is then emailed out to a list of subscribers. The current plan is to hookup a self-hosted listmonk server to my personal gmail and then use [this jekyll plugin] (https://github.com/masukomi/JekyllMail) to turn my posts into emails automatically. Self-hosting is extremely gratifying, but does feel like designing a rube goldberg machine and then having to use it in order to make breakfast every morning.  </p>
<p><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><br><em>What this cartoon doesn&#39;t show is that the professor, upon waking, would have to reset and maintain the machine.</em></p>
